scoringPolicy.name: FAIR-MOFs synthesis-condition accessibility
scoringPolicy.formula: record = mean(temperature accessibility, log-time accessibility); family = empirical-Bayes shrinkage of the unique-condition median toward the global prior
scoringPolicy.duplicateRule: One effective observation per normalized DOI plus condition fingerprint.
scoringPolicy.abundanceBoundary: Raw family frequency is never normalized into a score. Sample size affects only shrinkage strength and evidence confidence.
scoringPolicy.outcomeBoundary: The score describes severity of reported successful synthesis conditions, not probability of synthesis success.
